description: This file implements asynchronous subscription management for RBUS, including handling retries, thread management, and subscription lifecycle functions.

classes.name: AsyncSubscribeRetrier_t
classes.description: Structure managing the list of subscriptions, synchronization primitives, and thread control for asynchronous subscription retries.

classes.name: AsyncSubscription_t
classes.description: Structure representing an individual subscription, its payload, retry timing, and associated data.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_FreeSubscription
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a subscription item.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_CompareHandle
methods.description: Compares a subscription item handle with a given handle.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_CompareSubscription
methods.description: Compares a subscription item with a given subscription based on handle, event name, and filter.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_DetermineNextSendTime
methods.description: Determines the next time to send subscription requests based on scheduled retry times.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_SendSubscriptionRequests
methods.description: Iterates over scheduled subscriptions and attempts to send subscription requests if due.

methods.name: AsyncSubscribeRetrier_threadFunc
methods.description: Main thread function managing the retry loop and timing for subscription requests.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_Create
methods.description: Initializes the retrier structure, mutexes, condition variables, and starts the thread.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribeRetrier_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops the thread, and destroys synchronization primitives.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_AddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a new subscription to the retrier list and signals the worker thread.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_RemoveSubscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription from the retrier list based on the subscription handle.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_GetSubscription
methods.description: Checks if a subscription with specific handle, event name, and filter exists.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes all subscriptions associated with a specific handle and destroys the retrier if empty.
